purpose: RX 7900 XTX automatic contexts after the DMS output clamp, the memory-bound MTP draft vocabulary drop and the pool reserve fix; floors for tests/test_slow_qwen38_24gb_serving_capacity.py. Not a throughput or task-quality benchmark.
request: Each case starts `hipengine serve --model <model> <serve_arguments>`, reads the effective context from /v1/models, sends one greedy chat request at 97% of it (max_tokens 16), then four ~2K-token requests at once where capacity is automatic, and checks /ready.
provenance_note: The six cases ran in three passes on frozen trees as fixes landed: MTP-off cases before the draft-head size fix (unaffected), INT8+MTP/DMS after it, BF16+MTP after the pool reserve fix. The reserve fix only raises the pool budget and leaves context sizing unchanged. bf16_mtp_off_c1 passed its depth check; its served prompt count was not captured.

rows.name: dms_int8_mtp
rows.startup_output_limit: 135,169 tokens after a short prompt, 65,536 after 131,072

limitations: Automatic contexts are validated settings, not maximum searches; one synthetic full-depth request per case. Two-slot automatic capacity on BF16+MTP is the existing (4, 2, 1)-reaching-32K policy.
